notes: Scale measured independently from printed room sizes, not from the tracer: 6 rectangular rooms (5 first floor, 1 lower level) plus the 81'-6" edge dimension all fall in 10.31-10.46 px/ft, so the tracer's 10.36 is confirmed within 0.3% and is NOT wrong on this evidence; the disagreement with published square footage must come from elsewhere (e.g. footprint/area computation, the sheet's sq ft including full-height masonry walls, or both levels being summed). Both levels are drawn at the same scale (Bedroom 4 agrees). span was unreliable (hit wrong/far walls for Garage 2, Garage 1, Bedroom 2 width, Bedroom 3 height, Owner's Suite), so most sizes were read from zoom-3/4 crop rulers, about +/-1.5 px per edge. Garage 1 depth is taken to the deeper left part of its jogged front wall (262.5 px); to the shallower right part it is about 253 px (10.0 px/ft). Wall rectangles are approximate, read from the overview; missing = Bedroom 2 west wall, Bath 2/pantry west wall, Garage 1 west wall lower part, Bedroom 4 south wall, Exercise Room north and west walls, Owner's Suite south wall west part; extra = wet bar and wet bar 2 counter blocks, two entry porch columns (lower confidence).
